policy.task_retention_help: Work directories are kept only for running, review or blocked tasks. Unused directories are deleted without a backup. Capacity thresholds control regenerable caches.

policy.retention_help: Thresholds trigger verified cache cleanup. Archive retention is preserved; code, outputs, logs and session files are archived before directory reclamation. Zero disables a cache TTL or capacity threshold; zero archive retention allows immediate archival.
